colophon: Every figure on this page is measured by rmhbot from Discord gateway events — voice sessions timed from join to leave, messages counted as they are sent, games timed from rich presence. Nothing is estimated and nothing is self-reported. The written summaries are generated from those same figures and a sample of his own messages; the prose is a machine's, the numbers are not.
colophon-link: Is Sohum Joshi a bum yet?
colophon-scope: One account is tracked, by explicit configuration. Message text is kept only long enough to summarise the day it belongs to and is then deleted; the totals and the write-ups are what remain.
colophon-sibling: The four terms he set himself are reviewed separately.
day-quiet-body: No voice, no messages, no games. Either he was doing something else or he was not online at all — this page cannot tell the two apart, and neither can his résumé.
